name: Unique Label Cover
reason: No charge clears the citation bar ON THIS SOURCE. The only citation reductions.network attaches is Khot, On the power of unique 2-prover 1-round games, STOC 2002 - which CONJECTURES the hardness of this problem (it is the Unique Games Conjecture) rather than proving a value for it, so the approximation charge value is 'open/conditional', not established. FLAGGED AS THE LEAST SAFE REJECTION IN THIS FILE: Unique Label Cover is not a mere restriction of label-cover in practice (its approximability behaves qualitatively differently, and perfectly-satisfiable instances are easy), and an unconditional value may well be establishable from the 2-to-2 Games Theorem (Khot, Minzer & Safra) - which this source does not cite and which was NOT verified here. Recommend a targeted re-screen against that literature before treating this rejection as settled.
